福爾摩沙小導遊臺南 Tainan・中西區

金華府Jinhua Temple

認識碼頭工人、許家的守護神、五條港的進出口貨物，還有門口的甘蔗。

Meet the dock workers, the Xu family's guardian god, and the cargo of the Five Channels.

夾在兩棟街屋之間，是一座可能是你見過最苗條的廟。規模雖小，心意極大。五條港全盛時期，搬運貨物需要大批工人，這一帶滿是他們的身影。船出口糖、米、鹽、樟腦，進口絲綢、陶瓷、茶葉和香料。相傳 1830 年，來自福建晉江的許姓工人為家族守護神建了金華府。這正是神農街許藏春的家族。兩岸的許家人靠著兩地的金華府遙遙相繫。看看廟門口：幾株甘蔗，悄悄訴說著糖業貿易的往日榮景。

Squeezed between two street houses stands maybe the slimmest temple you will ever visit. Small in size, large in devotion. In the busy days of the Five Channels, moving cargo took armies of laborers, and this quarter was full of them. Ships sailed out with sugar, rice, salt and camphor, and came in with silk, ceramics, tea and spices. Legend says dock workers named Xu, from Jinjiang in Fujian, built this temple in 1830 for their family's guardian god. It was the family of Xu Cang-chun from Shennong Street. Twin Jinhua temples kept the family on both shores together. Look by the gate: a few stalks of sugarcane recall the golden age of the sugar trade.

為什麼值得來

Why it matters & history
  1. 最苗條的廟夾在兩棟街屋之間，廟內空間十分侷促。Sandwiched between two street houses, its inside is very narrow.
  2. 碼頭工人與許家相傳 1830 年，來自福建晉江的許姓工人為家族守護神建了金華府。Legend says workers named Xu built Jinhua Temple in 1830 for their family's guardian god.
  3. 五條港的貨物進口的是絲綢、陶瓷、茶葉與香料；出口的是糖、米、鹽與樟腦。Coming in: silk, ceramics, tea and spices. Going out: sugar, rice, salt and camphor.

認識景點

About the place

最苗條的廟The slimmest temple

門面只比街屋略寬：側身繞過香案，你就穿過了整座廟。 小而齊全：大廟的每個元素都縮小了，一樣不缺。 祈求吉慶四件套：旗、球、戟、磬，在這裡也找得到。 門口的甘蔗：訴說著許家與五條港糖業貿易的榮景。

Barely wider than a house: Squeeze past the incense table and you have crossed the whole temple. Small but complete: Every part of a full temple is made smaller, with nothing left out. The four lucky objects: Find the flag, ball, halberd and chime here too. Sugarcane at the gate: The sugarcane remembers the age of sugar.

碼頭工人與許家Dock workers and the Xu family

碼頭工人：五條港全盛時期，搬運貨物需要大批工人。 守護神：一個家族的守護神。 許藏春的家族：就是神農街那位許藏春的家族。 兩岸的金華府：他晚年回到晉江，兩岸許家靠兩地的金華府相繫。

dock worker: Moving cargo took armies of laborers. guardian god: The guardian god of a single family. Xu Cang-chun's family: The same family as Xu Cang-chun on Shennong Street. Twin temples: Twin Jinhua temples kept the family on both shores in touch.

勞動者的紀念碑：它是五條港勞動者留下的百年紀念碑。

A monument to workers: It is a century-old monument to the working people of the Five Channels.

五條港的貨物Cargo of the Five Channels

糖：台灣當年的招牌出口貨之一。

sugar: One of Taiwan's star exports.

實景照片

Photos on site

神農街上的金華府 From the street

金華府夾在兩間街屋中間，門面只比旁邊的房子寬一點點，難怪被叫作最苗條的廟。門前街上還掛滿了彩繪燈籠。

Jinhua Temple is squeezed between two street houses. Its front is only a little wider than the houses beside it, so people call it the slimmest temple. Painted lanterns hang over the street in front.

金華府的門面 The temple front

直立的綠色匾額寫著「金華府」三個金字，四周都是精細的木雕。門邊對聯「華鑾坐鎮神佑黎民」、「金闕承宣靈昭化人」，頭一個字合起來就是「金華」，意思是神明保佑大家。這裡主祀關聖帝君，也供奉馬府千歲。

The tall green plaque says Jinhua Temple in gold, with fine wood carvings all around. The first characters of the two door couplets spell Jinhua, and the lines say the gods protect the people. Guan Gong is the main god here, and Lord Ma is worshipped too.
